subject: Draft deal roadmap & pricing clearance for AltairHealth MAP
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Ramos <lisa.ramos@altairhealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@altairhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + initial MAP (v1.2)

Thanks for the time this morning — quick recap and next steps from the discovery: 

High-level takeaways:
- Primary use case: bedside summarization and triage for ED clinicians (low-latency, PHI-handling).
- Peak concurrency: ~120 active sessions at peak; average request size ~450 tokens.
- Key nonfunctional needs: VPC deployment option, audit logs, SOC2 attestation evidence.

Attached: Altair-MAP-v1.2.pdf (draft milestones + responsibilities) and SOW-draft.docx (initial scope).

Suggested MAP milestones (from call):
1) Prep & security review (Altair & Redwood) — target: 2 weeks
2) Pilot (10 clinicians, integration with EHR) — target: 6 weeks after signoff
3) Expand to 3 ED sites & latency optimization — target: +6 weeks

Open questions we flagged that will affect pricing/commit:
- Will Altair require VPC/on-prem for pilot or only for production?
- Expected commit level for year 1 (tokens/month) — affects discount band.
- Any additional regulatory evidence needed beyond SOC2 (e.g., HITRUST)?

Next steps: 
- Lisa/Tom: confirm whether pilot can run in Redwood Dedicated (VPC) vs Private.
- Altair procurement: share preferred contract template if different from our standard.
- Redwood: we will draft a MAP showing milestones, owner, target close date and a pricing/commit recommendation for exec review (looping in Ben and Grace).

Thanks — I’ll open an internal thread for pricing clearance once we get the pilot environment answer.

--
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Healthcare
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
From: Lisa Ramos <lisa.ramos@altairhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@altairhealth.com>
Cc: Altair Health Procurement <procurement@altairhealth@altairhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + initial MAP (v1.2)

Jordan — thanks for the summary and attachments. A few clarifications from procurement and clinical ops: 

- Pilot environment: Clinical ops prefers Dedicated (VPC) for the pilot given PHI flow. We can consider Redwood Private for production, but want to start in Dedicated.
- Regulatory: SOC2 + HITRUST would be ideal; if HITRUST is a long lead, provide a mitigation plan.
- Commit: we cannot commit to a large annual token number before pilot. For pricing, can you propose a pilot credit plus a pay-as-you-go rate, and then an option to convert to a committed tier after successful pilot?

Procurement note: we have a clause about data residency and a standard PO cadence. We will share a contract template by EOD Wednesday.

Lisa
Director, Clinical Innovation
Altair Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-19T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Altair MAP — pricing clearance request (need guidance on credits & commit)

Team — forwarding Altair thread. Key ask from customer: pilot in Dedicated (VPC) + pilot credits and an option to convert to committed tier afterwards. Pricing levers we can use: pilot credits, short-term promotional commit band, or discounted overage rate during pilot.

Attachments: Altair-MAP-v1.2.pdf, SOW-draft.docx, pricing-summary.xlsx (attached to this internal forward).

Specifics I need from you: 
- Ben: recommend pilot credit amount and suggested conversion commit levels (monthly tokens) and associated discount bands.
- Grace: assess risk/ops impact of Dedicated for pilot and whether we can offer a temporary reduced SLA for pilot to reduce price.
- Marissa: any similar comps we can point to for reference (healthcare pilots) and exec precedent on credits for pilots converting to commit.

Goal: I'd like to land an internal decision by EOD 4/20 so I can get back to Altair with an offer that includes an explicit convert-to-commit option and propose a target close date (end of Q2).

Thanks — Jordan

--Forwarded message--
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T14:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Altair MAP — pricing clearance request (need guidance on credits & commit)

Jordan — quick thoughts:

1) Pilot credits: recommend $25k in pilot credits applied to usage during the 8-week pilot. That covers expected pilot token consumption headroom and shows commitment.
2) Convert-to-commit proposal: three tiers to propose after pilot (monthly token commit):
   - Bronze: 50M tokens/month — 10% discount
   - Silver: 150M tokens/month — 18% discount
   - Gold: 350M tokens/month — 26% discount + priority support
3) For Dedicated pilot we can offer "Pilot SLA" (best-effort) and a path to standard SLA on conversion. Grace, confirm infra ops constraints but I think we can support a 2-week ramp to Dedicated pilot with limited SLA.

If Altair wants guaranteed production SLA in pilot, that will increase price; suggest we surface that as an optional add-on in the quote.

Short answer: I approve $25k credits and the tiered commit bands. Happy to escalate to revenue lead for any exception.

—Ben

Date: 2027-04-22T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Updated MAP & pilot offer — next steps and target close date

Lisa / Tom — thanks for the clarifications. Attached is an updated MAP (Altair-MAP-v1.2.pdf) with responsibilities and a proposal summary. Key commercial points: 

- Pilot: Dedicated (VPC) — 8 weeks, includes $25k pilot credits applied to usage. Pilot will run under a Pilot SLA (best-effort) with option to upgrade to Production SLA on conversion.
- Convert-to-commit options after successful pilot: Bronze / Silver / Gold tiers (details in pricing-summary.xlsx).
- Regulatory path: Redwood will provide SOC2 artifacts immediately; HITRUST mitigation plan attached (high-level).

Requested ask from Altair: 
1) Confirm pilot start window (we have capacity to start the week of 5/10) — target close/PO by 6/30 to convert to a Q3 rollout.
2) Procurement: please share your contract template (we will review redlines).

If those items look good I’ll prepare a concise quote and SOW for signature and route a pricing exception to revenue if Altair requests deeper credits. DocuSign link for an acknowledgement of the MAP (nonbinding) is here: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/altair-map-ack.

Thanks — Jordan

--
